metadata.note: Exercises synthesized for dataset use. Use under supervision and do not replace clinical judgment.

exercises.name: neck isometric 1
exercises.description: A isometric exercise targeting the neck. Clear, progressive, and appropriate for home or clinic.
steps: Start in a neutral, well-supported position.
Use a iband for added resistance or support as needed.
Perform the movement focusing on the neck through a controlled range.
Complete 8-15 repetitions (or hold isometric for 10-30s) and rest 30-60s.
Repeat for 2-4 sets depending on tolerance.
exercises.cues: Keep breathing steadily, exhale during exertion.
exercises.precautions: Maintain neutral spine/head; avoid jerky movements.

exercises.name: neck self massage 2
exercises.description: A self massage exercise targeting the neck. Clear, progressive, and appropriate for home or clinic.
steps: Begin with a gentle warm-up of 1-2 minutes (marching in place or shoulder rolls).
Use a balance pad for added resistance or support as needed.
Perform the specified mobility or proprioceptive drill for the neck.
Do 8-20 repetitions or practice for 30-90 seconds as tolerated.
Finish with gentle breathing and reassess comfort.
exercises.cues: Keep breathing steadily, exhale during exertion.
exercises.precautions: Stop if you feel sharp or increasing pain. Start gently and only progress as tolerated.
